name: Jain Marmo Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Jain Marmo Industries Ltd is in the business of trading and manufacturing Marbles, Granites, and other Stones & Minerals[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
JMIL is engaged as a Quarry Owner, Processors, Importers & Exporters of Marble Blocks, Slabs & Tiles. It is a part of the Jain Group and is 
one of the largest manufacturers and traders of:
a) Indian Marble
b) Green Marble
c) White Marble
d) Rainforest Green Marble
e) Granites 
f) Blocks
g) Slabs

pros: Debtor days have improved from 249 to 115 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -5.70% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -2.90% over last 3 years.
